description: Defines structures, functions, and constants for gathering and representing system GPU information without starting a GPU driver, including vendor IDs, device IDs, and GPU details.

classes.name: VersionInfo
classes.description: Stores version components: major, minor, subMinor, and patch.

classes.name: GPUDeviceInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a GPU device, including vendor ID, device ID, driver details, and detailed driver version.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Holds overall system GPU information, including list of GPUs, active GPU index, and platform-specific flags.

methods.name: GetSystemInfo
methods.description: Gathers system GPU info without starting a GPU driver; returns true if successful.

methods.name: PrintSystemInfo
methods.description: Outputs system GPU info to stdout.

methods.name: IsAMD
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to AMD.

methods.name: IsARM
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to ARM.

methods.name: IsImgTec
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to Imagination Technologies.

methods.name: IsIntel
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to Intel.

methods.name: IsKazan
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to Kazan.

methods.name: IsNVIDIA
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to NVIDIA.

methods.name: IsQualcomm
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to Qualcomm.

methods.name: IsSwiftshader
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to SwiftShader.

methods.name: IsVeriSilicon
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to VeriSilicon.

methods.name: IsVMWare
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to VMWare.

methods.name: IsVivante
methods.description: Checks if a vendor ID corresponds to Vivante.

methods.name: GetDualGPUInfo
methods.description: Uses heuristics to identify the GPU used for 3D graphics, setting relevant flags.
